nodes.name: Invite Webhook (Inbound)
nodes.notes: FastAPI create_invite POSTs { email, workspace_name, invite_link, role } here. The PRODUCTION url of this node is the value for N8N_WEBHOOK_INVITE_URL on the VPS. responseMode=lastNode so an SMTP failure returns non-2xx to the app, which then logs 'invites.n8n: n8n returned <code>'.

nodes.name: Send Invite Email (SMTP)
nodes.notes: Attach a Gmail SMTP credential after import. Host smtp.gmail.com, Port 465, SSL/TLS = on (secure). User cozy.downloads.store@gmail.com. Password = a Google APP PASSWORD (not the account password), entered manually in the n8n UI.

_meta.description: Phase 51 workspace invite delivery. FastAPI create_invite (rag/routers/tenant_invites.py::_fire_n8n_invite) POSTs { email, workspace_name, invite_link, role } to this webhook; the Send Email node delivers the invite via Gmail SMTP.

smtp_credential.password: Google App Password — entered manually in the n8n UI, never committed.
